text: N G prism. Your components, in full spectrum.
Instead of writing stories, you describe a component where it lives: one Showcase decorator, with its variants and its states.
N G prism scans your library and builds the styleguide from it.
Every input gets a control. Change it, and the component follows live. Outputs show up as events.
Switch hover, focus and pressed states on the canvas, and check the box model down to the pixel.
Every variant gets an accessibility check, so a contrast problem shows up before your users find it.
Your J S Doc becomes the API page: description, usage and examples, without a separate docs file.
Add it to your project with one command.
